d:
Mdm Malim was a bitter 50 year old woman who was barren and her husband divorced her years ago because she couldn't give him children. Her anger and resentment at others who have kids festered until one day, she decided she will obtain a baby from a pregnant woman.

She lured 26 year old first time mum Candice Jen, whom she befriended on an online motherhood forum, to her house on the pretext of giving her some baby products. Once Candice was inside, Mdm Malim quickly choked her out and then used a knife to obtain the baby. Sadly the baby did not survive.

Mdm Malim disposed of Candice's body in a suitcase and left it under an overpass. She was discovered 3 days later by a hobo who called the cops and they traced the suitcase back to the killer.

Candice's husband was devastated and paid the best mortician in town to restore the beauty to his decomposing and gutted wife.

He was pleased with the end result at her funeral.

What do you think of the mortician's work?
